responsibility: Implements the SPU port’s C-family frontend hooks rather than core code generation. It defines target preprocessor builtins and SPU-specific context-sensitive handling of the vector keyword/macros, adjusts C option behavior such as main warnings, and most importantly resolves overloaded SPU builtins by matching argument trees against backend builtin signatures before building the final call expression, bridging C parsing with the target builtin tables maintained by the SPU backend.
